Polyglot Fingerprint Matrix: All 28 Models Across All 10 Benchmark Scenarios
Models ordered by 6-language coding throughput. Generation & coding cells display end-to-end tok/s and (estimated output tokens); short/logic cells show wall-clock seconds.
★ Peak cell: claude-haiku-5.5 Rust = 91.1 tok/s (1,235 tok, 13.56s)
1. Java vs. Go / JS Token-Density Bias
Both take ~16.4s; Java (813 tok) hits 50.6 vs Go 31.4 tok/s.
2. The C++ Terse-Output Collapse (4 GPT Models)
4 GPT-5 models emitted 27–37 tok on C++ (~2 tok/s).
Rust emits 2.2× Go/C++ volume (25.8s mean wall time).
